_meta.units: Gy/ka per ppm (U, Th) or per % (K), infinite matrix, secular equilibrium
_meta.source_note: Values transcribed from the DRAC v1.x lookup tables (github.com/DRAC-calculator). The adamiec_aitken_1998 set has been checked against Tables 5 and 6 of the original paper; verify the other sets against their publications before relying on them.

adamiec_aitken_1998.reference: Adamiec G. & Aitken M.J. (1998) Dose-rate conversion factors: update. Ancient TL 16, 37-50.
adamiec_aitken_1998.note: Checked against the paper and the Luminescence R package (tests/test_reference_data.py).

guerin_2011.reference: Guérin G., Mercier N. & Adamiec G. (2011) Dose-rate conversion factors: update. Ancient TL 29, 5-8.
guerin_2011.note: Central values from the paper (Th and K: Tables 1 and 3; natural U: Table 2 weighted by abundance). The paper gives no uncertainties; the relative uncertainties of Adamiec & Aitken (1998) are carried, as in DRAC. Checked against the paper and the Luminescence R package (tests/test_reference_data.py).

liritzis_2013.reference: Liritzis I. et al. (2013) Dose-rate conversion factors: update and uncertainties. Mediterranean Archaeology and Archaeometry 13, 1-15.
liritzis_2013.note: Values and uncertainties checked against the Luminescence R package transcription (tests/test_reference_data.py).
